slides.text: Borkena, citing residents and the Ethiopian Red Cross, reports **Moyale** has calmed, but **road movement is still restricted**; talks are **not independently confirmed**.
The Rio Times reports **Addis Ababa residents** say plain-clothes officers **detained young people**; there is **no official statement**, and accounts are **unconfirmed**.
**Amnesty International** says on **Nov 23** it wants an **independent investigation** into artillery fire on residential areas of **Alamata**.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
